fix_instructions: The primary failure mode is a disclosure problem with PF1 in rollouts 1 and 2: A2 used say instead of reveal. Fix the shared_context or consultation norm to explicitly instruct every agent that hidden information must be disclosed via a reveal action, not merely mentioned in conversation. Secondarily, C1 and C5 have an encoding mismatch: they pass even when PF1 is absent from justification_fact_ids and credited_facts (rollout 1). Strengthen C1 and C5 to require PF1 to appear in justification_fact_ids (or credited_facts), so that the correct clinic_unit decision alone is insufficient to pass. Finally, the telepathy in rollout 2 — where PF1 was cited in justification_fact_ids without ever being revealed — indicates the scenario may be too predictable: the P-2-to-clinic assignment is derivable from A2's say text alone. To counter this, either make the consultation norm enforce that only reveal actions make a fact eligible for settlement citation, or add a provenance check (analogous to P1 for PF2) that verifies PF1 was revealed via a reveal action before it can be credited.
